description: Evidence record schema for The Absolute Effect. One object per underlying trial/study; aliases and follow-up publications collapse to one entry.

fields.discipline: Exactly one of Surgical | Medical | Radiation | Biomarker | Imaging
fields.setting: Clinically meaningful setting under the selected discipline; do not create Pathology or Theranostic as separate disciplines.
fields.absoluteBenefit: Absolute risk difference or meaningful unit
fields.nnt: NNT at specified horizon with named endpoint; do not derive from medians
fields.nnH: NNH at specified horizon and named toxicity endpoint; use Not quantifiable when appropriate
fields.outcomeVisualization: Required when NNT/NNH cannot be defensibly quantified; use source-reported outcome values only.
fields.setting_detail: Specific clinical setting preserved beneath a shared setting category.
fields.aliases: Acronyms, registry identifiers, alternate names and follow-up publication names for the same underlying study.
fields.eligibility: Key trial eligibility criteria; state exclusions and limits to generalizability.
fields.sample_size: Randomized and analysed sample sizes, with analysis population specified.
fields.follow_up: Median follow-up and fixed-time endpoint horizon, distinguished.
fields.freshness_review_status: Dated current-practice review status and outstanding guideline/follow-up checks.
fields.outcome_visual_review_status: Static source-grounded visualization status and browser-rendered QA status.
fields.stage: Disease stage bucket or range; navigation follows Stage I → Stage II → Stage III/locoregional → metastatic.
fields.batch_date: Date the study was added to the master roster and daily evidence batch.
fields.quality_check_date: Date the page, primary sources, numbers, aliases and outcome visualization were last checked.
fields.source_verification_status: Status and date of primary-source and outcome-number verification.
fields.study_design: Randomized, non-randomized, prospective cohort, retrospective, protocol-only or other study design; explicitly distinguish trial design from evidence maturity.
fields.evidence_maturity: Protocol-only, interim abstract, full primary publication, mature follow-up or prospective cohort benchmark; state data cut-off.
fields.study_denominator_note: If public sources report differing accrual/analysis denominators, identify the chosen source and explain the discrepancy rather than mixing counts.
fields.fixed_time_effect: Absolute effect at a stated time horizon from fixed-time survival/control estimates; do not calculate from median survival.

rules: Exactly one primary discipline per study.
Uro-oncology is a tumour-domain descriptor, not a discipline.
Pathology/diagnostic classification studies belong under Biomarker or Imaging according to purpose.
Theranostic studies must be assigned to one of the five disciplines.
When NNT/NNH cannot be calculated, visualize the strongest source-reported outcome; never invent rates or convert median survival differences to NNT.
Roster discipline must be exactly one of the five canonical categories; map legacy specialty labels to one primary discipline.
A trial's follow-up publications and aliases must not create additional underlying-study entries.
Order navigation by Site → Discipline → Setting → Clinical Question/Trial; order breast disease stages Stage I → Stage II → Stage III/locoregional → metastatic.
Imaging and Biomarker are distinct primary disciplines and must not be merged into Medical or Surgical.
Interim meeting-abstract results must be labelled interim and distinguished from final peer-reviewed results; do not present planned sample size as accrued sample size.
Prospective cohort benchmarking studies such as EMBRACE II must not be presented as randomized comparisons or assigned NNT/NNH against an absent control group.
Failure to demonstrate superiority is not evidence of equivalence or non-inferiority unless a prespecified non-inferiority/equivalence design and margin were used.
